business_summary: Shenzhen Jdd Tech New Material Co., Ltd engages in the research, design, development, production and sale of modified polymer protective materials in China. The company provides functional protective sleeves and functional monofilaments. It offers PUR pipe, fiber cloth tape, heat shrink braided tubing, super wear-resistant protective sleeve, flat spiral sheath, nylon non-shrink textile sleeve, braided mesh tube, PET telescopic braided mesh tube, and self-winding textile sleeve; thermal insulation sleeve, silver corrugated pipe, aluminum foil tape, heat shield, aluminum foil fiberglass tube and self-winding tube, and aluminum foil corrugated pipe; and double-layer self-winding textile sleeve. The company also provides lightweight shielding sleeve, self-winding shielding sleeve, and tin-plated copper braided tubing; polyester non-shrink textile sleeve, and nylon non-shrink textile sleeve; silicone fiberglass fireproof pipe, silicone fireproof tube, and high-temperature fireproof pipe; and rodent-proof corrugated pipe, cut-resistant corrugated pipe, PET quick-connect tubing, exhaust pipe insulation layer metallic braided mesh tube, tin-plated copper hook mesh, carpet sleeve, and patterned woven mesh tube. Its products used in automotive, construction machinery, railway, communication electronic, medical care, and other applications. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
